children: Indonesia raised 34 trillion rupiah ($1.92 billion) from a regular biweekly bond auction on Tuesday, the finance ministry said, higher than the indicative target of 32 trillion rupiah.
Total incoming bids reached 65.96 trillion rupiah, lower than the 84.8 trillion rupiah in the previous auction on August 18.
